segments.title_card: 决胜盘拼到最后，胜利才落定
segments.kicker: 北京第三轮 · 郑钦文 VS 布兹科娃

Oh, it drops in!
噢，这球落在界内！

So the first set goes to Zheng Qinwen.
首盘归郑钦文！

Coach likes that.
教练很满意。

Crowd certainly likes it.
观众当然也很喜欢。

Now confirmed that that ball did drop in.
现在确认了，这球确实落在界内。

Extra cheer from the crowd in Beijing.
